Independent project; not affiliated with DeepSeek. Requires "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"Node.js 24 or newer; locally tested with **DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 and Node.js 24.18 on Windows**. DSH is a d"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"eveloper preview: a new host version needs compatibility checks."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| Plugin | Purpose |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Voice input | Hold to record; local SenseVoiceSmall recognition. Browser audio processing is disab"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"led when supported. |
| Upload button | Composer attachments through DSH's input and file services. "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"|
| Vision reader | Image input and a vision tool using the configured model provider. |
| Document "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"companion | Document display, extraction, and search. |
| Plugin manager | Manage third-party profil"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"e plugins; official host plugins are outside its scope. |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Plugin features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Voice input: turn speech into an editable draft"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Hold the composer's microphone button or the configured shortcut to record. Release it to transcri"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"be and append text to the draft, then edit and send it when ready.
- SenseVoiceSmall runs on the loc"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"al CPU and supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and Cantonese. After downloading the model an"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"d engine, recognition works offline without a cloud speech account."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Upload button: attach files to a conversation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Click the upload button in the composer toolbar to choose one or more files and preview them as ca"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rds without changing the text being edited. Failed sends retain the cards for retrying. The configur"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"able per-file limit defaults to 64 MiB.
- Remove attachments before sending, deduplicate identical u"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ploads, and open sent attachments from their cards in chat history. This plugin transfers files; pai"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"r it with document companion when you want the agent to read document contents."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Vision reader: inspect images with an agent"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Pasting images into a conversation automatically saves local copies while retaining the original i"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"mages in the message. PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF are supported, with up to 10 images per operation.
- T"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"he separate `vision` tool takes an image path and a question to a configured vision model for tasks "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"such as screenshot analysis, reading image text and explaining charts. This uses a model provider; t"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"he main conversation model must also accept image input."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Document companion: read and discuss documents side by side"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Click the book button in the composer toolbar to open a reading panel beside the chat. It supports"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT and Markdown, with continuous scrolling, single-page mode and adjustable "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"panel width.
- Share the current reading position with the agent to ask about the visible page, read"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" a specified page or block, search extracted text, jump to a position or switch documents. PDF pages"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" are read through a vision model by default, requiring a configured, working model provider."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Plugin manager: manage third-party plugins and DSH updates"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Open **Settings → Plugins → Manage** to inspect third-party plugin versions, runtime state and dat"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"a locations, enable or disable plugins, and restore disables made by the manager. Changes take effec"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"t live when the host and plugin support it.
- Check updates and reinstall supported npm-sourced plug"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ins; update this collection through its shared installer. A separate **DSH host update** section sup"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ports standard global npm installations. Official plugins are excluded from ordinary plugin toggles;"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" replacing package code or upgrading DSH still requires a restart."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Rigor 4 records requirements, plans, execution evidence, child tasks and independent reviews to help"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" assess an agent's completion claims. It has its own repository and installer and is not included in"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" the five-plugin collection above."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install and remove"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"With DSH and pnpm already installed, one command installs the collection. On Windows, close DSH befo"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"re replacing or removing packages so native dependency files are not held open; start `dsh web` afte"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"acing or removing packages so native dependency files are not held open; start `dsh web` afterwards."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The same installer is also available directly from the public GitHub release:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Use `setup --preview` to inspect the plan first. The installer verifies release checksums, stores ar"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"chives and extracted packages inside **`<DSH_HOME>/third-party/`**, backs up the profile manifest, a"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"nd calls the official DSH CLI to register the five packages. DSH keeps its native runtime resolution"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" under `profiles/<profile>/node_modules`; the installer does not patch the host installation. Re-run"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" the versioned command to repair or update this collection. Existing custom data paths are preserved"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"the versioned command to repair or update this collection. Existing custom data paths are preserved."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Remove the collection with `npx --yes useful-dsh-plugins@0.5.1 uninstall`. Personal data is retained"},{"id":"p26s2","text":". Optional `--profile`, `--dsh-home`, `--dsh-package`, and `--store-dir` support custom installation"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s. The older aggregate package is removed during migration to avoid duplicate bundle rows; the new n"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"pm package is a zero-dependency installer."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"For individual advanced installation, put the archive inside the same third-party archive directory "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"and use the native CLI below."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Download the built `.tgz` for a plugin from Releases. Install it using the official CLI:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"To remove it:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Repeat with the package name in the table. DSH registers and removes each package's `dsh.bundle` aut"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"omatically. Restart after installing, updating, or removing package files. Disabling a loaded plugin"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" is a separate operation; see the manager's documented live-reload conditions."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Privacy and licenses"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Plugin code is MIT. Model weights and downloaded inference binaries retain their upstream licenses. "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"Speech recognition runs locally. Vision requests use the configured provider; document or image cont"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"ent sent to a model follows that provider's data handling. No personal settings, credentials, conver"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"sations, uploads, or recordings belong in this repository.
